interviews.notes: Regression for the booking flow is about 40% automated with Selenium; the rest is manual and takes 4 days per release. Peak-load testing was last done before summer 2025 and nobody owns it. Defects are tracked in Jira and ageing is visible, but escaped defects are not measured. PCI evidence is pulled together manually from emails and spreadsheets each release. Release go/no-go is a judgement call by the PO; there are no defined exit criteria.

Cypress suite of about 1,200 tests runs nightly in GitHub Actions, but flakiness means ~30% of runs need reruns. Two squads are trialling a GenAI assistant for test case drafting with no shared guardrails. Each team has its own Jira dashboard; there is no cross-ART view. Most testing happens late in the sprint.

One shared Maximo test environment; refreshes take 3-4 weeks and block regression. A small Selenium pack covers work-order creation only. Test data is copied from production without masking. Regression cycles are coordinated by email with the vendor.

Quarterly Oracle updates are regression-tested manually over about two weeks by business users. No automation. Test scope is decided ad hoc from Oracle release notes. There is no documented test standard for HCM.

API tests exist for the integration layer in Postman but there are no contract tests with downstream partners. Pipelines have unit-test gates only; a failing gate can be overridden by any lead. Production monitoring exists for infrastructure but there are no SLOs for customer journeys.

There is no enterprise QE strategy; each ART decides its own approach. QE roles differ by vendor and are not defined internally. Release confidence is based on the regression pass rate and a demo to the business.
Payment provider changes are tested in a shared UAT environment. Synthetic monitoring is not in place for booking. Audit evidence is retained in SharePoint folders manually.

Fare rules are written in Confluence without testable acceptance criteria. Contract tests cover 6 of 9 payment gateway APIs and fare-calculation API regression runs on every merge. The pipeline blocks merges when API tests fail, but there is no performance gate. PCI scope for the new gateway is not yet reflected in test evidence. Cutover readiness criteria are still being drafted.

snapshots.narrative: Baseline after the first week of interviews. Provisional enterprise QE maturity is 2.1 / 5, with Future-Ready QE and QE Talent & Enablement the least developed pillars. Early evidence points to gaps in Automation Engineering, Predictive Quality Intelligence, Production Quality & Observability. Coverage is still low, so these are hypotheses to test in the remaining interviews.
